about: Ladder 8a (ADR-134): the most bytes each part of a reader's first load may take, locked at the values the build measured when the budget was set. The landing draws every reading in data/quality-history.json, which the gate's promote adds a row to after each version, so the drawn index.html and the entry script may also grow by per_history_row bytes for each row past history_rows, and by nothing else. tests/budgets/byteBudgets.test.ts reads the built site in the gate's node job and fails a version that spends more. A version that needs more raises a number here in its own commit and says why in its changelog line; a number never rises to fit.
